services.title: Residential Roof Installation
services.text: When your home needs a new roof, it’s certainly an investment that you will take seriously.
body: When your home needs a new roof, it’s certainly an investment that you will take seriously. Hiring a seasoned roofing professional is necessary for accuracy as well as for the benefits of a warranty if your roof has one. The last thing you want is to spend time and money on a roof that falls apart in a matter of months due to poor installation.

about.title: About DR Roofing and Construction
text: At DR Roofing and Construction, we take pride in our customers experience, quality of work, honesty and integrity. Our knowledgeable team of professionals works to make every roofing and remodeling project as hassle-free as possible. We know that choosing the right contractor can be stressful and overwhelming, but the DR team is here to help you get the protection and the beauty that your home deserves, without the headaches!

We serve all of Greater Houston and the surrounding areas with two amazing locations! Wherever you have the need for roofing and home improvement, we are just around the corner to assist in any way we can. DR ROOFING AND CONSTRUCTION is your choice for a roofer in Houston! Contact us today!

Whether you’re looking for help with your insurance claim, or small monthly payments that fit into your family’s budget, we offer it all! We can work to get insurance claims approved that would often get denied, and we have a finance department that specializes in all credit situations.
